blocking.heading: ### N-1 | BLOCKING | origin=changed | new, introduced by the F-02 fix at SPEC:62

rejected.N-2: Grading sentence A holds: `docs/a.md` and `docs/a.txt` in one worktree both map to `docs/a.return-contract.yaml` under the F-02 clause, which contradicts WC-11 and the N-1 promise on the same line, so the second write replaces the first. Grading sentence B fails: the first sentence names `<output-dir>` as "the directory the coordinator passed", which for `--output <file>` is a file, so it does not supply a parent directory. F-02 is the specific clause for file-valued outputs and names the stem-based path, so `docs/return-contract.yaml` for every file-valued run follows only if the general first sentence is assumed to override F-02, which the text does not say. The finding requires both outcomes, so it is rejected. The A case alone is text-supported and could be restated as a separate finding, but this verification does not add one.
